# Two settlements through the same HKD bank: money in, then the same money out.
# The second is refused.
#
# A USD invoice is settled into `Assets:Bank:HKD`, which puts 1,560.00 HKD in
# the book at 0.172 with an available balance to match. A USD bill is then paid
# out of that same account for the same 1,560.00 HKD.
#
# Spending currency a basis still accounts for has to say which cost basis it
# comes out of, and a
# payment block has nowhere to say it — its bank split is written by GnuCash's
# `ApplyPayment`, not by the file. Allowed through, it drifted twice: the
# account was left empty while `fx-balances` still reported 1,560.00 HKD
# available (measured), and the cash left at the payment day's rate rather than
# at what it cost, so an account holding no HKD is left holding a CAD figure
# whenever the two rates differ.
#
# What this fixture produces: the invoice settles, and the bill is refused with
# a message naming the account, the balance available on it, and the
# `txn_guid:` route that can name a basis —
# tests/fixtures/fx_hkd_spent_by_retarget.txt does the same spending that way.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_what_a_settlement_brought_in.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Vendor"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-HKD-IN"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 2
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-HKD-IN"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 1560.00
		memo: "Payment for INV-HKD-IN"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD

bill "BILL-HKD-OUT"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		action: "Materials"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 2
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-HKD-OUT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-26
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 1560.00
		memo: "Payment for BILL-HKD-OUT"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
